shared_elements: horizontal bands or registers of repeated signs/patterns
justification: The most specific correspondence is that both are vertical stone surfaces organized partly into horizontal bands containing small profile figures/signs, including bird-like forms and round/oval marks. The biggest difference is that A has a framed, orderly scene with two human figures and linear inscriptions, while B is a rougher relief surface dominated by animal/abstract forms in stacked zones with no comparable central human interaction.
